'''Kombat''' is a one-day 2on2 tournament played '''Friday 4th March''', 21:00 / 22:00 {{Abbr/CET}} with entries for higher and lower divisions. 
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match.
== Format ==
* Separated higher and lower divisions.
* Lower division start at 21:00 {{Abbr/CET}}
* Higher division start at 22:00 {{Abbr/CET}}
* Top teams from lower division will move forward to higher division.
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}

== Rules ==
